title: 연애 3년, 1분 요약
style: Korean young man in his twenties, soft and a little awkward, short natural lines

art.style: Korean webtoon gag-comic illustration, same look as a modern Korean comedy YouTube banner: confident thin black ink outlines with slight hand-drawn wobble, flat bright colors with soft cel shading, warm cream (#FFF8E7) background with subtle orange halftone dots, highly expressive exaggerated faces, comic symbols (sweat drops, motion marks, hearts, swirls, exclamation marks) drawn around characters, clean and polished, funny but warm.
art.cast: HE (always the same person): a Korean man in his mid-twenties, slim, short black two-block haircut with soft bangs, thin round black-rimmed glasses, kind droopy eyes; default outfit: navy crewneck sweatshirt and beige chino pants. SHE (always the same person): a Korean woman in her mid-twenties, shoulder-length light brown wavy hair with see-through bangs, big bright eyes, small face; default outfit: cream knit cardigan over a white t-shirt and light blue jeans.
art.layout: Vertical 9:16, ONE single illustration (not a comic page, no panel grid). Keep the characters large and centered in the middle 60% of the frame. Keep the top 12% and the bottom 25% simple (background only) because captions are added later. IMPORTANT: no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark anywhere in the image, including phone screens and signs.
art.sheet: Character reference sheet for a Korean webtoon: HE on the left and SHE on the right, each shown full body from the front standing in their default outfit, plus three small head shots of each (happy, shocked, crying). Plain warm cream background. No text, no labels.

scenes.meet: At a lively university club welcome party, HE holds a paper cup and freezes, staring across the room at SHE who is laughing with friends; his eyes turn into big pink hearts, sparkles and a soft pink glow around her, love-struck motion lines.
scenes.insta: Late at night in his dark bedroom lit only by a phone screen, HE lies ALONE in his bed under a blanket scrolling on his phone with a guilty, sweating, wide-eyed face; the phone screen shows only a grid of blurry photo thumbnails (no text, no icons).
scenes.kakao: HE sits on the floor of his room staring intensely at his phone lying in front of him, a wall clock behind him, sweat drops, holding his thumbs back from typing with visible effort, a little devil and angel version of himself floating on his shoulders.
scenes.movie: First date in a dark movie theater: HE and SHE sit side by side, both extremely stiff and nervous, staring straight ahead, a big popcorn bucket between them completely untouched, his hand frozen halfway toward it, glow of the screen on their faces.
scenes.confess: Night street under a warm streetlight, HE holds a small bouquet of flowers out with both hands, bowing slightly, face bright red and eyes squeezed shut; SHE covers her mouth with both hands in surprise, cheeks pink, small hearts floating around.
scenes.hands: Walking side by side on an autumn street with falling leaves, HE and SHE hold hands for the first time, both looking away from each other with bright red faces; a comically exaggerated waterfall of sweat drips from their joined hands.
scenes.couple: HE and SHE at a cute cafe wearing identical matching pastel couple hoodies, matching rings and matching phone cases, taking a selfie together making heart signs with their fingers, very happy, sparkles around.
scenes.backhug: On a riverside park at sunset with cherry blossom petals falling, SHE gives HE a back hug from behind; HE is startled and melting with happiness, steam coming out of his ears, both faces glowing pink.
scenes.menu: HE stands holding a phone showing restaurant photos (no text), suggesting food options with a hopeful face, while SHE sits with arms crossed, a casual but picky face shaking her head; a pile of rejected food thought bubbles (pizza, ramen, sushi, burger) crossed out around them.
scenes.fight: In a cafe, HE and SHE sit back to back on the same bench with arms crossed, both angry and pouting, a dark storm cloud with lightning between them, other customers glancing awkwardly.
scenes.sorry: Late at night outside SHE's apartment building, HE stands holding a convenience store bag full of her favorite snacks and a small cake, bowing deeply with a pleading puppy face; SHE peeks out from the door with arms crossed, trying not to smile.
scenes.jealous: SHE leans in very close to HE, holding up her phone and pointing at it, eyes narrowed with a jealous, suspicious glare and a fiery aura; HE is sweating buckets and shaking his hands in denial; the phone screen shows only a blurry photo of another woman (no text).
scenes.boring: In a small living room, HE and SHE sit at opposite ends of the same sofa, each scrolling on their own phone with blank bored faces, a big empty space between them, a single tumbleweed rolling across the floor, dull grey-tinted colors.
scenes.forgot: At a restaurant table with a small cake and an unlit candle, SHE sits alone looking at her watch with a hurt, cold face; in the doorway HE rushes in panicking, out of breath, realizing he forgot their anniversary, a big exclamation mark over his head.
scenes.breakup: Rainy night under the same warm streetlight from the confession, HE and SHE stand facing each other without umbrellas, both crying quietly, SHE turning to walk away, raindrops and puddles reflecting the light, melancholic blue tones.
scenes.drunk: Late at night in a small Korean pub tent with green bottles on the table, HE sits alone, drunk with red cheeks and teary eyes, holding his phone close to his face, about to send a message, a swirly dizzy mark over his head.
scenes.invite: HE, a few years older with the same glasses, stands at his apartment mailbox holding an elegant white wedding invitation envelope decorated with flowers (no text), completely frozen in shock, jaw dropped, a crack-of-lightning shock effect behind him.
scenes.envelope: HE sits at his desk at night holding a plain white money gift envelope in one hand and a few banknotes in the other (no visible numbers), staring at them with a deeply conflicted, comically agonized face, sweat drops, a swirl of confused thought lines above his head.
